general_information.name: I THINK IT’S ROBERT MILLER.
general_information.address: I’m not quite sure what you mean there—do you want the street part, or the city and province too?

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly I’ve lost interest in things, and I’ve been tired. I’ve also been pulling back socially a bit, and sleep has been harder.
current_concerns.goals: I’d like to enjoy life again and stay active.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Carbidopa-levodopa.; Dose: It’s the 25/100 mg tablets, one tablet three times a day.; Start Or Duration: I started it in 2024, I think.; Side Effects: Occasionally it makes me a bit nauseous.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes — I’m also on latanoprost eye drops.; Dose: One drop in each eye nightly.; Start Or Duration: I started those in 2021.; Side Effects: None that I know of.
Medication 3: Name Or Description: Yes — allopurinol.; Dose: 100 mg daily.; Start Or Duration: I started it in 2019.; Side Effects: None known.

medical_history.medical_conditions: I have Parkinson’s disease, and that’s the main one I know about.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My granddaughter.; Diagnosis Or Condition: ADHD.; Additional Details: She was diagnosed when she was 9, I think.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Wine.; Quantity or frequency: Maybe monthly, and it’s minimal.; Duration: I don’t know.

education_employment_legal_history.highest_education: I have a bachelor’s degree, and I’m a teacher by training.
education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Oakville District School Board.; Job Title: High school science teacher.; Dates: 1978 to 2013.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and grew up… just a pretty ordinary childhood, really. Nothing much else I can think of.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: School was the big thing, and then I became a teacher. That’s most of it, really.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’ve been married for 49 years, and my wife has been supportive.
personal_history.future_goals: Mostly to enjoy life and manage the illness.
